title: Fighting Resumes at Kibati and Kafunsi, Paralyzing Walikale-Masisi Traffic
detail: FARDC and Wazalendo forces clashed again with AFC/M23 rebels on Sunday, Sept 13 around Kibati and Kafunsi in Walikale's Luberike grouping, extending into Milonge, Muhanga and Buhimba in neighboring Masisi territory. Road traffic remained suspended on the Kashebere-Mungazi axis, stranding travelers at Mungazi and Nyabiondo and cutting off supply and healthcare access for the affected communities. No casualty toll was reported.

media.caption: Road traffic suspended on the Kashebere-Mungazi axis amid renewed fighting at Kibati and Kafunsi, North Kivu, Sept 13, 2026

confidenceReason: Reported by CongoQuotidien citing several local sources; no FARDC or M23 confirmation and no casualty figures available.

title: Ebola Reaches Savo Plain Displacement Site in Ituri, 70,000+ at Risk
detail: Three confirmed Ebola cases were recorded among residents of the Savo Plain displacement site in Djugu territory, Ituri province, health officials said Sept 13. The three symptomatic patients were transferred roughly 20km to Fataki hospital, where testing confirmed infection. The site hosts more than 70,000 displaced people in severely overcrowded shelters — sometimes five to ten people per space — raising fears of rapid spread; response teams including MSF and Medair launched contact tracing while warning that sanitation and prevention resources remain insufficient for the population.

media.caption: Displaced families at the Savo Plain site in Djugu territory, Ituri, where three Ebola cases were confirmed, Sept 13, 2026

confidenceReason: Corroborated by Radio Okapi (tier 2) and CongoQuotidien citing health officials' case confirmation via Fataki hospital testing.

title: Tshisekedi Signs Ordinance Creating National Dialogue Organization Committee
detail: President Félix Tshisekedi signed an ordinance on Sept 13 establishing the Organization Committee for the National Dialogue on peace, cohesion and state "refoundation" that he launched Aug 28. The committee — a coordinator, deputy coordinator and members all appointed and removable by the president — is tasked with the dialogue's administrative, material and logistical preparation; its precise composition was not yet made public. The move comes two days before the opposition Coalition Article 64's planned Sept 15 march against Tshisekedi's constitutional referendum push, which critics say the dialogue is designed to help enable.

media.caption: Tshisekedi retains direct oversight of the National Dialogue Organization Committee he created by ordinance, Sept 13, 2026
